subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What exact pre-auth diagnostic fields may the Control UI collect and expose in a copyable session-only transcript?
rationale: The code boundary is clear, but the payload can include auth, device identity, origin, pairing, and browser security details; automation should not choose the redaction and support-copy policy for maintainers.

options.title: Approve redacted session transcript
options.body: Implement an in-memory diagnostic drawer that records only sanitized lifecycle phases, detail codes, timing, close data, and recovery hints, with redaction and non-persistence tests.

options.title: Limit to existing structured errors
options.body: Improve the existing login/error cards with the current structured detail codes, but do not expose a full transcript yet.

options.title: Fold into dashboard roadmap
options.body: Defer this to the broader live diagnostics/dashboard work and accept that pre-auth connection failures remain harder to self-diagnose for now.

recommendation.title: Approve redacted session transcript
recommendation.body: Implement an in-memory diagnostic drawer that records only sanitized lifecycle phases, detail codes, timing, close data, and recovery hints, with redaction and non-persistence tests.
